acceptance_criteria: Startup prop self-acceptance calls are classified SELF_ACCEPTANCE.
Each MORE/LESS logical probe carries one non-secret UUID request ID reused across retries, with distinct IDs between directions.
Every probe reports rows_in=1 without request-body capture or secret leakage.
Targeted, neighboring telemetry, scope, and protected exact-head CI pass with can_execute=false and V17 terminal authority unchanged.
The deployed Render SHA is the merge commit or a verified descendant with ancestry proof, and fresh SELF_ACCEPTANCE receipts show populated correlation before Reporter closure.

learning.why_existing_tests_missed_it: The startup probe test verified auth and fail-closed semantics but did not assert invocation-ledger caller classification, request correlation, row count, or retry identity stability.
learning.regression_test_added: test_live_probe_authenticates_more_and_less_and_logs_only_sanitized_metadata now forces transient retries and verifies stable SELF_ACCEPTANCE correlation without secret/body leakage.
learning.architecture_lesson: Internal callers sharing the Action credential must identify themselves with existing correlation headers; bearer authentication alone is not caller identity.
learning.preventive_control: Require every internal Action client to emit existing caller-class, nonsecret request-ID, and rows-in headers with deterministic retry-stability and no-body-capture coverage.

records.root_cause: The startup self-acceptance client authenticated with the production Action key but omitted the existing X-WOW-Caller-Class, X-WOW-Request-ID, and X-WOW-Rows-In telemetry headers, so intentional fail-closed 422 probes were persisted as ACTION_API_KEY with null correlation.
